settings.title: Share link lifetime
settings.summary: How long a new share link stays open.
settings.description: How long a new share link opens, from when it is made, such as 720h for thirty days. 0s makes links that open until they are turned off. A link made earlier keeps the time it was made with.

settings.title: Open share links
settings.summary: The most share links one person may have open at once.
settings.description: The most share links one person may have open at once. A link that was turned off or has expired does not count. 0 means no new link can be made, and the links already made still open.

settings.title: Images in shared chats
settings.summary: A shared chat shows the images in your messages.
settings.description: Whether a shared chat shows the images in your messages. Off, each image is named and not shown. Files other than images are only ever named.

settings.title: Artifacts in shared chats
settings.summary: A shared chat shows the artifacts its replies made.
settings.description: Whether a shared chat shows the artifacts its replies made, as their source and never run. Off, each is named by the step that made it.

settings.title: New link view
settings.summary: Whether a new link shows the chat live or as it was.
settings.description: What a new share link shows when you do not choose: live is the chat as it is when the link is opened, with later messages, and snapshot is the chat as it was when the link was made.
